name: metadump
description: takes a prompt (plus photos, files, web pages or videos if you have them) and turns it into a meta dump: one big self-indexing JSON chest of tiered keywords, anti-keywords, descriptions, patterns, references, sources, measurements, timings and transcripts that any skill or subagent can search like a search engine while it works. a resource to consult, not rules to obey. it can scrape pages, watch videos and build image moodboards with nothing to install.
